√stigh 'mount'
present: [5.] stighnoti stighnuyā́t stighnute 
[perfect: tiṣṭighe atiṣṭighat asteghiṣṭa steghiṣyate steghitā ]
verbal: -stígham 
secondary: intensive: teṣṭigh- -- desiderative: tiṣṭighiṣati tistighiṣa- tisteghiṣa- -- causative: steghayati 
These forms are somewhat amended from the MSS. (which have stiṅnoti etc.): see Schröder in ZDMG. xxxiii. 195.

√stim 'be stiff'
[perfect: stimyati stīmyati tiṣṭema tiṣṭīma etc. ]
verbal: stimita E.+ 
Compare √styā.
